review.notes: Full review against the new pins (Tau Ceti 2fd255d, Mathlib 1b1ccf4). The gate was rerun and fails on two checks: tex at README:1974 and an UPWARD edge to AnalyticStableMaps inherited from main. The dependency check reports 1 problem and no CYCLE. All 15 seeded targets were checked against bdho-cotangent, bdho-morse-dg, hatcher-at, abouzaid-viterbo and seidel-biased; 1.6 (Palais, uncertified) is not verifiable. Suggested.lean was elaborated with #check on all 44 declarations and one-tactic probes; a Theorem A statement elaborates at the pins. Main findings: Theorem A is statable but absent; Layers 0, 2 and 6 restate pinned Tau Ceti modules that are new since the previous pin; Layer 6.0 has a second owner in HamiltonianSystems (#480); the DifferentialGeometry Layer 10 citation is dropped by #886; Check signs in 4.3, 5.1, 7.4 and 8.1; #963 conflicts with no stated order.
